props.description: This table lists work orders and it's attributes Links out to transfer order line, work order process, work order process  distribution and, work order process BOM

props.label: Image
props.description: System flag indicates the image of the product

props.label: Number
props.description: Label field, and the number of the Work Order. This should also be the ID of the workorder.

props.label: Priority
props.description: The priority of Work Order

props.label: Quantity
props.description: The desired output quantity for the overall Work Order.

props.label: Active
props.description: Generally triggered by the state of the linked Kanban Rack.

props.label: Ext Product
props.description: String value of an Extenally defined product or item for manufacturing - this is only used, if products are not being used within Fuuz.

props.label: External Id
props.description: A link to a record from an external system.

props.label: Customer Reference
props.description: Use this field to identify the Customer associated with this work order - when you are not using Fuuz customer master data. This field can be populated manually - or through integration. Nothing in this field will be validated - it is free form.

props.label: Scheduled Start At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to start production - System Generated

props.label: Scheduled Finish At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to finish production - System Generated

props.label: Work Order Id:
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: Process
props.description: Process object (REQUIRED), the 'Default' process maybe used here, if the incoming data does not have a processID match in Fuuz.

props.label: Quantity
props.description: The desired output quantity for the overall Work Order.

props.label: Unit Weight
props.description: Weight per unit (DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Standard Pack Quantity
props.description: use to define a standard production/standard package qty for this product. When set to 0 no default will be made for the operator, if anything greater than 0, this will set the production default providing the Product Strategy Process was used to generate the Work Order, or if you manually configured this setting on the work order.

props.label: Description
props.description: A description for this work order process - that could be used to display to users - perhaps information pertaining to this specific production run.

props.description: component product object

props.label: Active
props.description: System flag indicates whether the BOM is active (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

props.label: Consumption Type
props.description: Select whether the Consumption Type is Actual (uses Min/Max/Std usage), Standard (uses Standard Usage), or None (does not use any of these values)

props.label: Standard Usage
props.description: Standard usage, of this component product, for 1 unit of output of the assembly product produced. UOM for consumption, based upon the component product strategy inventory UOM

props.label: Reference
props.description: Additional information

props.label: Allow Over Consumption
props.description: Allow overconsumption of loaded materials (quantity loaded can go negative during production).
